EquipmentLibrary.Description: Equipment definitions reused by the entity archetypes: kinematics, sensors and weapons.

KinematicDefinition.name: Kinematic
KinematicDefinition.Description: Root kinematic. Every kinematic derives from it and inherits its position and orientation.

Parameter.name: Position
Parameter.Description: Position of the entity when it is created.

Parameter.name: Orientation
Parameter.Description: Heading, pitch and roll of the entity when it is created.

Parameter.name: StallSpeed
Parameter.Description: Lowest speed at which the aircraft keeps flying. The kinematic never flies slower.

Parameter.name: MaxSpeed
Parameter.Description: Highest speed the aircraft can reach. The kinematic never flies faster.

Parameter.name: Ceiling
Parameter.Description: Highest altitude the aircraft can reach. Movement orders above it are capped.

Parameter.name: InitialSpeed
Parameter.Description: Speed of the aircraft when it is created, bounded by the stall speed and the maximum speed.

Parameter.name: MaxRange
Parameter.Description: Farthest distance at which the radar detects a target. Targets beyond it are never detected.

Parameter.name: FieldOfView
Parameter.Description: Total horizontal angle scanned by the radar, centred on the aircraft heading.

Parameter.name: Mode
Parameter.Description: Operating mode of the radar when the entity is created.

Parameter.name: MinRange
Parameter.Description: Shortest firing distance. A target closer than this cannot be engaged.

Parameter.name: MaxRange
Parameter.Description: Longest firing distance. A target farther than this cannot be engaged.

Parameter.name: MaxSpeed
Parameter.Description: Highest speed of the missile in flight, used to compute its time of flight.

Parameter.name: Armed
Parameter.Description: Whether the missile can be fired as soon as the entity is created.
